body.error: Python int too large to convert to SQLite INTEGER

notes: SURPRISE: Flask's <int:> converter is UNBOUNDED (Python ints), so an id larger than i64 matches the route and reaches the handler, where the sqlite3 bind raises OverflowError -> generic except -> 500 {"error": ...}. This contradicts the contract doc's claim that overflowing values 404. Compare STATUS only, never the error text (Python exception __str__ is not reproducible in Rust). A Rust u64/i64 path parser would naturally 404 here — parity requires deciding: match observed 500 or amend the contract.
